hints.title: Vowel Substring Definition
hints.text: A valid vowel substring contains only English vowel letters and includes all five distinct vowels.

hints.title: Contiguous Extension
hints.text: For each starting position, expand substrings as long as only vowels are encountered.

hints.title: Completeness Check
hints.text: Check if the collected vowel set size reaches five and increment the count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: All five vowels must be present and consonants break contiguous substring validity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Including any non-vowel invalidates the substring and all further extensions from start.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Small constraint N <= 100 allows clear quadratic window expansion.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should break inner loop immediately when encountering a non-vowel.
